hook: THOSE WHO ROSE|THE HIGHEST|ALL DID THIS

voices.name: l00
voices.text: The people who rose the highest <#0.2#> all knew how to do this.
voices.caption: The people who rose the highest all knew how to do this.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: Watch your feelings and thoughts <#0.2#> as separate from you.
voices.caption: Watch your feelings and thoughts as separate from you.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Marcus Aurelius wrote notes to himself, <#0.2#> even on military campaigns.
voices.caption: Marcus Aurelius wrote notes to himself, even on military campaigns.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Phil Jackson <#0.2#> taught Michael Jordan to meditate.
voices.caption: Phil Jackson taught Michael Jordan to meditate.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: People swept up by emotion <#0.3#> get dragged around.
voices.caption: People swept up by emotion get dragged around.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: People who can step back <#0.2#> choose their next move.
voices.caption: People who can step back choose their next move.
